integrity: The threshold-to-random-walk reduction, generating-function derivation, finite coefficients, and numerical constants were reconstructed and replayed with exact rational checks; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact closed form assumes a complete null, iid fair conditional knockoff signs, distinct nonzero magnitudes, and reciprocal nominal level q=1/r with integer r>=2.
Ties, approximate knockoffs, mixed null/non-null configurations, and nonreciprocal levels are not covered by the displayed formula.
The first-passage coefficients are classical; originality is claimed only for the identified exact complete-null Knockoff+ FDR law after the documented literature checks.
title: Exact complete-null FDR of Knockoff+ at reciprocal levels
